title: Tooling: 1.13x faster exact stage-pair audit with identical receipts
body:
The historical stage-pair audit spends most of its runtime in exact rational arithmetic. This replaces two wasteful patterns with identical operations, preserving every receipt and rejection check. **Tooling improvement; no new kappa.**

## Changes

1. `scripts/audit_fused_block.py` — `rational_rank` skips redundant `Q(x)` construction when an entry is already a `Fraction`. `Q(Q)` returns the same value after needless normalization.
2. `scripts/audit_stage_pair.py` — `modular_rank` converts denominators through a cached `_mod_inv(d, prime)` helper (same `pow(d, -1, prime)` call) instead of one fresh `pow()` per matrix entry. `lru_cache` does not cache exceptions, so a non-invertible denominator raises the same `ValueError`.

No matrix, pivot order, stopping rule, candidate list, or rejection predicate was touched.

## Measurements

Fresh-process timings of `certificate()` (compute only), CPython 3.12.14 / Windows, stdlib only. OS caches not flushed; host not isolated. Timing is descriptive, not a pass threshold.

| run | original (s) | optimized (s) |
|-----|---:|---:|
| 1 | 16.63 | 14.31 |
| 2 | 15.79 | 13.96 |
| 3 | 15.57 | 13.64 |
| median | 15.79 | 13.96 |

Median 15.79 s to 13.96 s: 1.13x faster, 11.6% less wall time. Microbenchmarks: `rational_rank` 3.05x on 50 sampled frames; modular conversion 1.42x on 20 sampled matrices.

```sh
python3 -B research/stage-pair-performance/benchmark.py --rounds 3
```

Expected: `PASS_IDENTICAL_STAGE_PAIR_RECEIPTS`.

## Validation

- Full `certificate()` output identical to `certificates/stage-pair-audit.json` in every field except the single expected `source_sha256` entry for the edited `audit_stage_pair.py` (rank sum 8684, 64 candidates, 6 local improvements).
- `audit_fused_block` and `audit_joint_frames` certificates regenerate byte-identical.
- New `tests/test_stage_pair_performance.py`: 6 tests compare optimized helpers against verbatim base-commit references on edge cases (empty, zero, singular, non-square, ints vs Fractions, 30-digit numerators, primes 101/103), including the `ValueError` path. Existing suites pass: `test_stage_pair` (8), `test_fused_block` (7), `test_joint_frames` (8), `test_quadratic_affine` (4).
- Full `make verify` and the selected-supplier cold replay were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change. `upstream/` untouched; selected frontier unchanged.

Claim, candidates, and overlap review in `research/stage-pair-performance/SELECTION.json`. No open PR covers the stage-pair audit (checked through [PR 823](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/823)).
